The Chinese characters for Luna

Origin and meaning

Luna is a Latin name meaning “moon”.

About the name Luna

The Roman goddess of the moon, and a character in the Harry Potter books.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “moon”, a Luna calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
